key_points: Record Q1 2027 operating margin (40%) but revenue muted by supply‑chain bottlenecks
Needham and Mizuho cut price targets to ~ $290, signalling lower near‑term expectations

Near‑term downside pressure likely; long‑term thesis remains intact but will be tested
